newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK likely to boost land supply for luxury housing.
newsitem.headline: HK likely to boost land supply for luxury housing.

text.p: The Hong Kong government is likely to increase substantially land supply for low-density or high-end housing development in 1997 and 1998, a senior land official said on Monday.

"During the last three years, I think we have actually disposed of about 17 hectares of land for low-density or high-end housing," Bowen Leung, Secretary for Environment Planning and Land, told reporters.
"This year and next year together, we are likely to be able to make available 70 hectares of land for such purpose," he said.
Leung said he hoped the increase in supply could satisfy the demand for land for high-end developments and stabilise their prices.
Some Hong Kong property developers have urged the government to increase land supply for luxury residential development, saying that is the solution for the sector's rocketting prices.
